task: PR #605 attached the NFS data disk with config.vm.disk, which crashes vagrant-vmware-desktop 3.0.5 (cap/disk.rb get_disk, File.extname(nil)) on every master-1 boot. Reproduce the hand-made working setup (vdiskmanager vmdk + nvme0:1 vmx keys) in the Vagrantfile and keep the boot guard.

events.summary: Change only how master-1 gets its NFS data disk on vmware_desktop (vmx keys plus a before up/reload vdiskmanager trigger), the NARWHAL_NFS_DISK_GB=0 guard, operations.md section 15, the lessons-log row and R327. Deliberately left alone: live VMs and the main checkout's .vagrant, 01-nfs-server.sh, gitops, the quota agent, VirtualBox behavior beyond moving config.vm.disk into its provider override.

2026-11-08 live: vagrant up master-1 crashed in cap/disk.rb:129 extname with nil. The owner migrated by hand with vmware-vdiskmanager -c -s 200GB -a lsilogic -t 0 narwhal-nfs.vmdk and nvme0:1.present/fileName in the vmx; the live vmx shows nvme0:1 with narwhal-nfs.vmdk and disk_meta is {}, so the plugin cleanup is a no-op.

D-NFS-VMDK-VMX: vmware no longer uses config.vm.disk; trigger creates the vmdk if missing, provider vmx keys attach it; VM dir resolved from .vagrant/machines/master-1/vmware_desktop/id (bare file name for an existing machine, .vagrant/narwhal-nfs absolute path for a first up). Guard now refuses NARWHAL_NFS_DISK_GB=0 when the vmdk exists.

events.scope: Static: ruby -c and vagrant validate on the Vagrantfile; a ruby harness evaluating the constants/guard against a fake layout (new machine, VM without disk, live layout with default, live with 0 refused, override accepted, bad value); R327 with 34 mutations including config.vm.disk reintroduced and the guard ignoring the vmdk. NOT covered: a real vagrant up (new cluster first boot with the absolute path, reload), VirtualBox override.vm.disk, vdiskmanager invocation.
evidence: test:ruby harness -> live layout default ok narwhal-nfs.vmdk, 0 aborts
